\begin{example} \end{example}[Scalar Conservation Law]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.7\group Examples of PDE

\[ u_t + \Div \mathbf{F}(u) = 0. \] For a classical solution, the equivalent nondivergence form is \[ u_t + \sum _i (F^i)'(u)u_{x_i} = 0. \] This is a first-order quasilinear equation with top-order coefficients $(F^i)'(u)$. \end{example}
